```{.r .cell-code}
# Read all expected frequencies into one tibble ------------------------
sim_truth <- tibble(
    sim_truth_path = list.files(
      inp$sim_info_dir, 
      pattern = "population_aa_multiloci_variants_freqs_prevs.tsv.gz", 
      full.names = TRUE, 
      recursive = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sim_truth = map(
      sim_truth_path, 
      read_tsv, 
      col_types = cols(
        .default = col_integer(), 
        population_name = col_character(), 
        country = col_character(), 
        variant = col_character(), 
        freq = col_double(), 
        prev = col_double(), 
        group_id = col_character()
      ), 
      progress = FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-sim_truth_path) %>%
  unnest(sim_truth) %>%
  rename(
    sim_id = population_name, 
    exp_freq = freq, 
    exp_prev = prev, 
    exp_n_samp = sample_count
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -pop, 
    -country, 
    -aas_in_variant, 
    -allele_count, 
    -total_samples, 
    -total_alleles
  )

# Read in all simulation parameters into one tibble --------------------
sim_params <- tibble(
    sim_params_path = list.files(
      inp$sim_info_dir, 
      pattern = "simulation_parameters.json", 
      full.names = TRUE, 
      recursive = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sim_params = map(
      sim_params_path, 
      jsonlite::fromJSON
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-sim_params_path) %>%
  mutate(sim_params = map(sim_params, as_tibble)) %>%
  unnest(sim_params) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -collection_year, 
    -obs_freq_monoclonal, 
    -obs_non_recombinant, 
    -mean_k, 
    -sample_count, 
    -est_between_sample_relatedness
  ) %>%
  rename(
    sim_id = population_name, 
    true_mean_coi = mean_coi
  )
sim_truth <- sim_truth %>%
  left_join(sim_params, by = "sim_id")

# Read in all FEM results into one tibble ------------------------------
tool_results <- tibble(
    tool_res_path = list.files(
      inp$tool_res_dir, 
      pattern = "*.tsv.gz", 
      full.names = TRUE, 
      recursive = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(tool_res_dir = dirname(tool_res_path)) %>%
  mutate(sim_id = basename(dirname(tool_res_dir))) %>%
  mutate(paramset_id = basename(tool_res_dir)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-tool_res_dir) %>%
  mutate(
    tool_res = map(
      tool_res_path, 
      read_tsv, 
      col_types = cols(
        .default = col_double(), 
        variant = col_character(), 
        group_id = col_character(), 
        sample_total= col_character()
      ), 
      progress = FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-tool_res_path) %>%
  unnest(tool_res) %>%
  rename(
    obs_freq = freq, 
    obs_prev = prev,
    obs_n_samp = sample_total
  )

# Read in tool parameters, and join ------------------------------------
tool_params <- jsonlite::fromJSON(inp$tool_params) %>%
  as_tibble()
  #mutate(mean_coi_tool_param = paramset$coi) %>%
  #dplyr::select(-loci_groups, -paramset)
tool_results <- tool_results %>%
  left_join(tool_params, by = "paramset_id")

# Join everything into one tibble --------------------------------------
tool_results_wtruth <- tool_results %>%
  # Use an inner join because FEM also estimates frequencies for 
  # subsets of the requested multilocus genotypes, and these 
  # frequencies are not benchmarked
  inner_join(sim_truth, by = c("sim_id", "variant", "group_id"))

sim_truth<- sim_truth|>
  mutate(exp_n_denom= exp_n_samp/exp_prev)

tool_results<- tool_results|>
  rename(obs_n_denom= obs_n_samp)

tool_results_wtruth|>
  mutate(exp_n_denom = exp_n_samp/exp_prev)|>
  rename(obs_n_denom= obs_n_samp)->tool_results_wtruth 

tool_results_wtruth$obs_n_denom<- as.numeric(tool_results_wtruth$obs_n_denom)
```
:::


# Allele Frequencies 

## Goals for allele frequencies: 

* Report RMSE (root mean squared error) across different groupings of populations, and simulation parameters. 

* Report Lin's concordance correlation coefficient with 95% confidence intervals between tool and simluation COIs across different groupings of populations, and parameters. 

* Compare tool allele frequences to Simulated allele frequencies using Bland-Altman plots (mean of tool and simulation vs difference of tool vs simulation) across combinations of loci, and simulation parameters. 
  * Can choose to split this up across different groupings of populations, and simulation parameters. 
  
* For each allele in each locus, report number of samples that contain a false positive (allele detected in sample with tool but not truly present in simulation), and that contain false negatives (allele not detected in sample with tool but is truly present in simulation). Report these as proportions (sensitivity, specificity). 
  

::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Compute RMSE of frequency and prevalence -----------------------------
tool_results_with_rmse <- tool_results_wtruth %>%
  group_by(
    sim_id, 
    paramset_id, 
    country, 
    group_id, 
    pop_alpha, 
    coi_p, 
    coi_r, 
    k_s
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    freq_rmse = sqrt(mean((obs_freq - exp_freq)^2)), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Show all RMSEs as a boxplot ------------------------------------------
tool_results_with_rmse <- tool_results_with_rmse %>%
  mutate(
    group_id = factor(
      group_id, 
      c(
        "six_med_div", 
        "six_low_div", 
        "four_group1", 
        "two_group1", 
        "pfdhfr_pfdhps", 
        "pfdhps", 
        "pfdhfr"
      ), 
      labels = c(
        "Six, Medium Diversity", 
        "Six, Low Diversity", 
        "Four", 
        "Two", 
        "pfdhfr/pfdhps", 
        "pfdhps", 
        "pfdhfr"
      )
    )
  )%>%
  mutate(
    pop_alpha = factor(
      pop_alpha, 
      c("2.33", "9", "99"), 
      labels = c("High Sim. Rel", "Med. Sim. Rel", "Low Sim. Rel")
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    k_s = factor(
      k_s, 
      c("0.5", "0.2"), 
      labels = c("Med. Recombination", "High Recombination")
    )
  ) %>%
  # coi_p was varied in synchronicity with coi_r to produce different 
  # polyclonality levels, and thus coi_p is implicitly included when 
  # using coi_r as a plotting aesthetic
  mutate(
    coi_r = factor(
      coi_r, 
      c("0.25", "0.5"), 
      labels = c("Low COI/Prop. Polyclonal", "Med. COI/Prop. Polyclonal")
    )
  )

tool_results_with_rmse %>%
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = pop_alpha, y = freq_rmse, color = group_id)) +
  geom_boxplot() +theme_bw()+
  facet_grid(rows = vars(k_s), cols = vars(coi_r)) +
  labs(
    x = "Simulated Relatedness", 
    y = "RMSE of Allele Frequency Estimate", 
    color = "Loci Set"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")-> RMSE_byScenario_freq

print(RMSE_byScenario_freq)
```

## Preliminary conclusions for allele frequencies: 

* In general the tool performs best with fewer loci of lower diversity among samples with lower COI.  

* There is high concordance between true and estimated allele frequencies for all simulation scenarios and loci sets except those involving six high diversity loci. 

* These patterns are driven by the tool's inability to detect all alleles in the sample (false false negatives), and these are more common for low frequency alleles, and among samples with higher COI. 

# Allele Prevalence

## Preliminary conclusions for allele prevalence: 

* In general the tool performs best with fewer loci of lower diversity among samples with lower COI.  

* There is high concordance between true and estimated allele prevalences for low COI simulation scenarios however for higher COI simulation scenarios multiple loci sets show poor concordance including the set of six high diversity loci and several drug resistance markers. 

* In general, the greatest discrepancy between the true and estimated allele prevalence is found when the prevalence is between 0.25 and 0.5.
